Area.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/5] The potential role of heterosexism in suicide and suicide attempts may also extend beyond alienation, bullying and internalised homophobia. Other factors also linked to heterosexism have been found to increase L/B/G suicide risk. These include depression (Proctor & Groze, 1994; Remafedi et al., 1991; Schneider et al., 1989), alcohol and drug abuse (DuRant et al., 1998; Faulkner & Cranston, 1998; French & Power, 1998; Israelstam & Lambert, 1989; Nardi, 1991; Rosario et al., 1997), social isolation and rejection (Rotheram-Borus & Fernandez, 1995; Schneider et al., 1989), an early age at "coming-out" (Hershberger, Pilkington, & D'Augelli, 1997; Nicholas & Howard, 1998), and issues around HIV and AIDS (Buhrich & Loke, 1988; Marzuk, Tierney, Tardiff, & et al., 1995; Remafedi et al., 1991).
